newsitem.title: CAMBODIA: Royalist dissident ready to take first PM job.
newsitem.headline: Royalist dissident ready to take first PM job.

text.p: A senior member of ousted First Prime Minister Prince Norodom Ranariddh's royalist party said on Saturday he was ready to replace him as Cambodia's first prime minister.
Toan Chay, who broke with Ranariddh in April, said he would take the job as first prime minister if the FUNCINPEC party chose him.
"I will be the first prime minister if they (the party) need me to be," he told reporters.
Toan Chay, a former provincial governor, appealed to his royalist party members not to flee the country and said those who had left had nothing to fear and should come back.
"We (want) to make people gain hope. Do not fear, do not run out of the country," he said. "Come back to align with the government."

Dozens of FUNCINPEC members and royalist sympathisers fled the country in the aftermath of two days of fighting in the capital last weekend, which sealed Ranariddh's overthrow by powerful Second Prime Minister Hun Sen.
